verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for an account-based government data platform like SAM.gov, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about retention periods, deletion of user or entity data, or user-controlled retention settings. The tiered data-access and API-key documentation covers access control, an adjacent topic, and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
